read_scope: JSON files only; no image/pt access, no metric recomputation, no GPU

statistics.unit: one clip/source per condition; equal clip weight
statistics.spread: sample standard deviation across the 8 HQ sources or 2 REDS sequences; ddof=1
statistics.training_seed_statistics: not applicable: frozen deterministic VAE without training or sampling seeds
statistics.inference: descriptive pilot audit; no p-values, generalization CI or training-effect claim
statistics.PSNR_aggregation: mean of recorded per-frame PSNR within each clip, then equal-clip mean; not PSNR of pooled MSE
statistics.latent_gap_aggregation: per-clip all-channel RMSE = sqrt(mean(channel_gap_rmse**2)); condition values are equal-clip mean and sample SD
statistics.channel_distribution_aggregation: means/sample SD across per-clip channel means or population stds; mean of population stds is not a pooled global std
statistics.normalization_reference: Wan constants define the affine normalization. Data channel means need not be zero and stds need not equal one; no forced moment matching is justified
statistics.temporal_metric_caveat: TecoGAN tLP/tOF depend on frame intervals and selected content; comparisons across stride/length are descriptive and not duration-normalized
